31   DERECOGNITION OF SUBSIDIARY (ANANTAYA GLOBAL SOLUTIONS (PVT) LTD)
During the year, the Group’s 70%-owned subsidiary, Anantaya Global Solutions (Private) Limited, was struck off from the register of
companies. As a result, the Group lost control of the subsidiary with effect from 31st December 2025. In accordance with SLFRS 10,
the Group derecognised the assets, liabilities, and non-controlling interest relating to the subsidiary on the date control was lost.
